chunks: My father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated that Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said: I asked Abul Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him)
about the man who has a spot on his face that water did not reach when he performed ablution. He said: It suffices for him to moisten it with moisture from some part of his body.
ai.seo_question: What to do if a spot on the face is missed during wudu?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith highlights the jurisprudential principle of *ease* (taysir) within Shia fiqh, demonstrating that minor oversights in wudu do not invalidate the entire act. Imam al-Rida (AS) provides a practical, non-rigorous solution—moistening the dry spot—reflecting the Imams' emphasis on removing hardship for the common believer while maintaining the integrity of ritual purity.
